description: TCS collapses its inferred chain into one weighted edge
derivation: Hand-traced against TCS::computeGraph. Sequences AAAA, AAAT, ATTT: distances H1-H2=1, H2-H3=2, H1-H3=3. Level 1 connects H1-H2 directly. Level 2 connects the {H1,H2} component to H3 via H2 (findIntermediates keeps u=H2, v=H3, path length 2), creating one unlabelled intermediate with two unit edges. Level 3's H1-H3 pair is now within one component and is skipped. The post-pass collapses the degree-2 intermediate into a single H2-H3 edge of weight 2. Ids by sorted sequence: AAAA->H1, AAAT->H2, ATTT->H3.
